children: MetaVia announced that Phase 1 trial data for DA-1726 has been accepted for an oral presentation at the Precision Liver Symposium 2026.
The presentation is scheduled for November 4 at 1:35 p.m. MT at the Hilton Denver City Center.
The presentation title cites MRI-PDFF and weight reductions with relative preservation of lean mass in a randomized, placebo-controlled trial.
DA-1726 is a dual GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist being developed for metabolic disease.
Sarah Browne, MetaVia’s chief medical officer, will present the data.
